August 2, 2025 - Group buying, also known as collective buying, offers products and services at significantly reduced prices on the condition that a minimum number of buyers would make the purchase. Origins of group buying can be traced to China, where it is known as Tuán Gòu (Chinese: 团购), or team buying.

A Group Buy (or GB) is a term widely used in the keyboard community, which is super similar to crowdfunding. This is a process in that each customer unites together and uses the collective buying power to purchase goods at a reduced price or at all.
